environment.description: Same Go binary packaged as a Lambda function (custom runtime via provided.al2023) exposed through a Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource-based policy does NOT include a principal wildcard (*) — it specifies only the internal service role arn:aws:iam::491827364510:role/catalog-frontend-renderer which has lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission. The Function URL's CORS configuration has AllowOrigins set to [] (empty, no origins allowed). There is no API Gateway, no CloudFront distribution, and no public proxy in front of the Function URL. Callers without valid SigV4 credentials for the authorized role receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before the Lambda is invoked.
